payload.tension: The passage states 2 Corinthians 1:20–24 names God’s Spirit within a source unit where the Spirit is given; the wording centers attention on “Also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
